rules: same Chrome version viewport reset model prompt budget and task deadline across structured adapters
failed runs retain elapsed or capped wall time and are not removed from latency analysis
computer-use is reported as a separate vision track
adapters may report unsupported but may not silently replace a requested task with an easier one
all mutating tasks use an independent verifier outside the acting adapter

runner reports prompt-to-verified only when the independent verifier passes; rejected outcomes retain prompt-to-verifier-decision latency separately. A valid client prompt-dispatch timestamp on the same monotonic clock is required, prompt-to-final comes from the client trace, and absent boundaries leave prompt spans null
performance claims require prompt-to-verified and prompt-to-final evidence, complete traces, and p50/p95 non-regression
